equally.en: The two treatments produced equally strong effects across the entire sample.
equally.zh: 两种处理在整个样本中产生了同样强的效果。

equally.en: Both groups are equally entitled to appeal the committee's final decision.
equally.zh: 两个群体都有同等权利对委员会的决定提出申诉。

equally.en: Municipal investment in transport is equally important for sustained regional development.
equally.zh: 市政交通投资对区域可持续发展同样重要。

uniquely.en: The dataset is uniquely suited to studying regional income inequality across decades.
uniquely.zh: 该数据集特别适合用于研究数十年来区域收入不平等的问题。

uniquely.en: This case uniquely illustrates the limits of the existing evaluation framework.
uniquely.zh: 这一案例独特地揭示了现有评估框架的局限。

uniquely.en: Each participating region contributes uniquely to the national research program.
uniquely.zh: 每个参与地区都为全国性研究计划提供独特贡献。

nearly.en: Nearly every participant reported improved concentration after the training intervention.
nearly.zh: 几乎每一位参与者都报告说培训干预后注意力有所改善。

nearly.en: The published literature provides nearly no evidence for such a strong claim.
nearly.zh: 已发表的文献几乎未提供支持这一强主张的证据。

nearly.en: The two instruments measure nearly the same construct, so their results converge.
nearly.zh: 两套工具测量的构念几乎相同，因此结果趋于一致。

almost.en: The trial almost failed to recruit enough participants from rural hospitals.
almost.zh: 该试验险些未能从乡村医院招募到足够的参与者。

almost.en: Recovery was almost complete when the follow-up survey was administered.
almost.zh: 随访调查实施时，受试者的恢复已接近完全。

almost.en: Almost every subsector reported persistent shortages of qualified data analysts.
almost.zh: 几乎所有子行业都报告合格数据分析人员持续短缺。

thoroughly.en: The authors thoroughly reviewed the evidence on early intervention programs.
thoroughly.zh: 作者全面审查了关于早期干预项目的证据。

thoroughly.en: The records were thoroughly cleaned before they entered the statistical model.
thoroughly.zh: 这些记录在进入统计模型之前经过了彻底清理。

thoroughly.en: Thoroughly documented procedures allowed independent teams to replicate the analysis.
thoroughly.zh: 详尽记录的操作流程使独立团队得以重复该分析。

fully.en: The model fully explains the variation observed across the two counties.
fully.zh: 该模型完全解释了这两个县之间观察到的差异。

fully.en: Participants were not fully aware of the purpose of the archive search.
fully.zh: 参与者并未充分意识到档案检索的目的。

fully.en: Full replication became possible only after the analysis code was fully documented.
fully.zh: 只有在分析代码得到充分文档化之后，完全的重复研究才成为可能。

entirely.en: Responsibility for data collection lies entirely with the participating clinics.
entirely.zh: 数据收集的责任完全由参与诊所承担。

entirely.en: The new measure is entirely different from the instrument used previously.
entirely.zh: 新测量方法与此前的工具完全不同。

entirely.en: Entirely new vocabulary items were added to the standardized reading test.
entirely.zh: 标准化阅读测验中新增了全新的词汇条目。

completely.en: The absence of a control group completely undermined the causal interpretation of the results.
completely.zh: 缺乏对照组彻底削弱了对结果的因果解释。

completely.en: Urban and rural samples were completely comparable in terms of age distribution.
completely.zh: 城乡样本在年龄分布方面完全可比。

completely.en: The new reporting standard completely reshaped how journals document sampling procedures.
completely.zh: 新的报告规范彻底重塑了期刊记录抽样流程的方式。

totally.en: The two instruments are totally incompatible with the original scoring scheme.
totally.zh: 这两套工具与原有评分方案完全不相容。

totally.en: The reform did not totally eliminate the gap between urban and rural regions.
totally.zh: 该改革并未完全消除城乡地区之间的差距。

totally.en: These measures are totally inadequate for assessing long-term learning outcomes.
totally.zh: 这些测量手段完全不足以评估长期学习结果。

partially.en: The results partially support the hypothesis that early intervention reduces dropout.
partially.zh: 结果部分支持早期干预可减少辍学的假设。

partially.en: Funding was only partially restored after the audit had been completed.
partially.zh: 审计完成之后，拨款才只是部分恢复。

partially.en: The available data partially obscure the effect of training on staff retention.
partially.zh: 现有数据部分掩盖了培训对员工留任的影响。

minimally.en: The intervention had minimally affected productivity across the participating firms.
minimally.zh: 该干预对参与企业的生产率影响极小。

minimally.en: Participants received only minimally adequate training in statistical methods.
minimally.zh: 参与者只接受了最低限度的统计方法训练。

minimally.en: The policy minimally reduced the administrative burden on small businesses.
minimally.zh: 该政策仅在极小程度上减轻了小企业的行政负担。

extensively.en: The phenomenon has been extensively studied across disciplines and national settings.
extensively.zh: 该现象已在多个学科和不同国家情境中被广泛研究。

extensively.en: The coastal wetland was extensively converted into farmland during recent decades.
extensively.zh: 近几十年间，该沿海湿地被大面积改造成农田。

extensively.en: The authors extensively reviewed studies published on early childhood language acquisition.
extensively.zh: 作者广泛评述了关于幼儿语言习得的已发表研究。

systematically.en: Sampling was systematically conducted to reduce selection bias in the analysis.
systematically.zh: 抽样工作被系统地实施，以减少分析中的选择偏差。

systematically.en: The department systematically collects data on graduate employment outcomes each year.
systematically.zh: 该部门每年系统地收集毕业生就业结果数据。

systematically.en: Researchers systematically applied the screening protocol to all retrieved records.
systematically.zh: 研究者系统地对所有检索到的记录应用了筛选方案。
